title: Scoped negative result: restored 2+3-cycle boundary costs exactly ten
body:
The disjoint swap-plus-three-cycle boundary left open in #1216/#1145 needs **exactly ten primitives**, even with any finite number of restored dirty donors. This is a scoped negative result and exact boundary price, with no new kappa.

A new cycle-sensitive write lemma strengthens the donor cap: a permutation moving `m` coordinates in `c` nontrivial cycles needs at least `m+c` moved-coordinate writes. Thus a nine-step 2+3-cycle word can write to at most one restored donor. Read-only donors specialize away, reducing the previously unbounded gap to six registers. Two separately represented complete F3 searches then exclude all words through length nine; the retained rational ten-step witness attains the bound.

The ternary-row implementation and adapted PR1216 bit-packed implementation agree on all **2,299,917 matrices/minimum distances** and independently perform **151,794,522 middle-gate tests**. An essential positive control has exact distance nine: its direct intersection is empty but it has **1,000 middle hits**, detecting accidental omission of the new scan. A third dense Python oracle checks complete GL(2,3)/GL(3,3) and every small-ball state. No finite search failure is presented as an unrestricted theorem without the stated reduction.

Freshly replaying all **168** pinned historical PR969 CK/JP8 boundary records gives an exact local component bill **252**, sharpening #1216's 238 lower bound. Disposable work costs 224, so separate complex-component lowering incurs **56 extra real primitives per orientation**. The explicit recurrence charges children, source access, preparation, adapters, other restoration, transport and dispatch; no supplier row saving or current selected-profile change is claimed.

Validation passes with CPython 3.12.13/3.14.7 and clang 21: full exclusion, rational witness/inverse/omissions, exact distance-nine control, source-bound census, five package test groups including optimized read-only relocation and on-disk corruptions, source pins, selected-record integrity and relevant repository tests. The registered **quick** replay explicitly omits the lower-bound scan; the new dedicated native workflow runs the full commands. Hosted CI success, full selected cold replay, physical admission, formal proof and human review are not claimed.

```sh
python3.12 -I -O -B research/restored-cycle-gap/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -B research/restored-cycle-gap/test_package.py
```

Expected: `PASS_RESTORED_CYCLE_GAP exact_minimum=10 ... historical_component_bill=252 no_new_kappa`, then five passing test groups. C++17 compiler required.

Exact base: `bce54fb3f895cbe5cd4c0eb477c3afeed100190f`. Seed **54**, recursive interfaces. #1216 pinned at `2cbf4084e141ba24ee3417ff014fdc7ca83b6c66`; #1145 at `fd4d5ffc448361297e717aa30eafed578caf8e61`. Full proof, source pins, scope change from the original card, open questions and validation are in `research/restored-cycle-gap/`. No selected/upstream/predecessor file is modified.

Credit Ross Richardson's #1216/#1145 model, reduction, witnesses and implementations; ToikY's actual #969 boundary construction; Sagar Thakrar #696, faw01 #839, Jeremy Kothe #622, Chafik Boukhalfa #626 and retained lineage. The adapted implementation and recognizer are identified; original proof/notice/source bytes are preserved. Prepared for Philipp / mightyOil with substantial **OpenAI Codex GPT-6 Astra assistance**. Apache-2.0. Coordinator review was a scoped written review, not independent execution of the exhaustive scan.
